items.description: Diagnostic inspection of the cracked laptop
items.rationale: The report shows 41,200 ÷ 52,000 = 79.23% battery capacity, below the 80% cutoff in §2.6.8, and no waiver applies. Sections 2.6.7 and 5.2.3 therefore exclude the diagnostic even though it established the coverage bar; €72 is the conditional estimate from Case 2.

items.description: Laptop screen and lower-right corner repair
items.rationale: The swerve impact and both damaged areas would otherwise qualify under §§2.6.2–2.6.3, but §2.6.8 excludes the entire unit at 79.23% battery capacity without a waiver. The photographed €549 parts-and-labour quote is the conditional estimate for the combined repair, not a payable amount.
